command: set -euo pipefail; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-callsite.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT; git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP"; cd "$TMP"; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo '--- LocalAudioArm references excluding tests/git ---'; grep -R -n --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=tests --exclude='*.md' -E 'LocalAudioArm|voice777_local_audio_arm' . || true; echo '--- PocketStreamingRenderer references excluding tests/git ---'; grep -R -n --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=tests --exclude='*.md' -E 'PocketStreamingRenderer|voice777_pocket_renderer' . || true; echo '--- executable/service references local_voice/Pocket ---'; grep -R -n --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=tests -E 'local_voice|pocket.*voice|voice777' scripts systemd DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,240p' || true; echo CALLSITE_AUDIT_DONE=1
